mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement (user_id, tid, amount, trade_date, settle_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tid}, #{amount}, #{tradeDate}, #{settleDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement SET attempt_token = #{token}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_token IS NULL AND attempt_count < 4

UPDATE settlement SET status = #{status}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_failed_at = #{now}, attempt_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM settlement WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

SELECT st.settlement_id, s.ticker, s.company_name AS companyName, st.amount, st.trade_date, st.settle_date, st.status FROM settlement st JOIN trade t ON t.tid = st.tid JOIN stock s ON s.sid = t.sid WHERE st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.status = #{status} ORDER BY st.settle_date DESC
